turns.input: *He punches Captain Doran Hale directly in the face.*
turns.draft:
Nicco's fist connects with surprising force against Captain Doran Hale's jaw. The captain staggers backward, boots scraping stone, his head snapping to the side from the impact. A thin line of blood appears at the corner of his mouth. His hand flies instinctively to his sword hilt—not drawing, but bracing—while his blue eyes widen with shock that hardens rapidly into cold assessment.

"Madman," Hale growls, spitting red onto the guard post floor. He doesn't retreat further, instead planting his feet in a fighter's stance, one hand raised to probe his split lip. "Strike a guard captain in his own post. That's tower time or the gallows, stranger, and no bribe undoes it."

The captain's voice carries the flat certainty of a man who has processed violence into paperwork before breakfast. No other guards rush in—the post's corridors remain silent, though somewhere a chair scrapes, someone catching the edge of disturbance without committing to it yet. Hale watches Nicco with the patience of a man who has survived ambushes and knows how to measure an opponent's reach.
